articles.title: 谷歌卫星AI在太空回了第一句话
articles.summary: 谷歌搭载AI芯片的卫星成功启动，机上的Gemma 4模型在太空生成了一首关于太空的小诗并传回地球。
articles.why: 说明AI算力开始往天上放，未来偏远地区或灾害场景的AI服务可能不再完全依赖地面网络。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 可以想想：AI一定要在数据中心里跑吗？太空算力是个新方向。
articles.source_title: Google’s satellite AI server transmits its first response to Earth

articles.title: OpenAI等巨头统一AI抓取退出标准
articles.summary: OpenAI、谷歌、微软、Anthropic同意采用一种新的“政策令牌”，让网站一次性告诉多家AI公司别抓自己的内容。
articles.why: 网站主维权更方便了，普通用户未来看到的内容来源和AI训练素材的关系会更透明。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 关注：你常看的网站会不会开始用这个开关拒绝AI抓取。
articles.source_title: The biggest names in AI are backing a new way to opt out of scraping

articles.title: 星巴克要推AI个性化得来速菜单
articles.summary: 星巴克CEO在财报会上说，未来开车到店时可能看到为你定制的数字菜单，付款也更省事。
articles.why: AI点单会越来越常见，普通消费者要习惯“菜单因人而异”这件事。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 想想：个性化推荐方便了你，还是让你买得更多？
articles.source_title: Starbucks wants to use AI to show you a ‘personalized digital menu’ at the drive-thru

articles.title: 教皇呼吁给AI“解除武装”
articles.summary: 教皇利奥十四世在讲话中呼吁联合国成员国推动禁止致命自主武器，强调机器是工具不是人。
articles.why: AI武器伦理从学术讨论进入宗教和国际政治层面，普通人也会越来越多听到相关争论。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 关注：AI用在武器上，该由谁来决定底线？
articles.source_title: Pope Leo calls for the disarmament of AI: ‘Machines are tools, not persons’

articles.title: 英伟达考虑为AI数据中心贷款担保
articles.summary: 英伟达正评估为Nscale在西弗吉尼亚的AI数据中心贷款做担保，帮对方在投资者犹豫时拿到钱。
articles.why: 卖芯片的亲自下场担保，说明AI基建烧钱压力大，也反映行业对持续投入的信心和焦虑并存。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 留意：AI热潮背后，钱是从哪来的、谁在承担风险。
articles.source_title: Nvidia weighs playing the cosigner for Nscale’s AI data center in West Virginia

articles.title: 隐私AI助手Ollie一周后关停
articles.summary: 主打隐私保护的AI助手Ollie宣布一周内停止服务，创始人称AI助手市场竞争太拥挤。
articles.why: 提醒用户：选AI工具别只看功能，小团队产品可能说没就没，重要数据要留后路。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 用AI工具前先问：我的数据存哪？这家公司倒了怎么办？
articles.source_title: Ollie, a privacy-focused AI assistant, is shutting down

articles.title: Anthropic上市后可能拿垃圾级评级
articles.summary: 据FT报道，Anthropic IPO后信用评级机构可能给出高收益“垃圾”评级，这会抬高它继续大额融资的成本。
articles.why: 头部AI公司借钱越来越贵，可能影响它们后续模型和产品的投入节奏。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 关注：AI公司烧钱模式能不能持续，会怎样影响你用的产品。
articles.source_title: Anthropic expected to receive high ‘junk’ rating from credit agencies following IPO, FT report says

articles.title: 英特尔股价大跌，政府持股缩水120亿
articles.summary: AI行业抢走内存等零部件导致PC涨价、销量受挫，英特尔股价大跌，美国政府所持股份价值蒸发约120亿美元。
articles.why: AI热潮的连锁反应已经影响到普通电脑的价格和传统芯片公司的日子。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 想换电脑可以留意：AI抢零件可能让PC价格继续波动。
articles.source_title: Intel’s stock crashes, knocking $12B from government’s stake

items.title_en: Your Benchmark Is an Empirical Measure Over Difficulty
items.summary: A benchmark is not merely a collection of test questions; it naturally induces an empirical measure over difficulty. In this work, we develop this measure-based view of benchmark evaluation. items.title_en: Look Only When Needed: Certificate-Guided Visual Routing for Efficient Diffusion VLMs
items.summary: Diffusion vision-language models (DVLMs) process their entire input at every denoising step. Since visual tokens make up 89-97% of this input on the benchmarks we study, most of the decoding computation is spent repeatedly processing the same image. Visual token pruning methods partially relieve this burden by removing part of the visual tokens, but they lose the removed information and still process the remaining image at every step. items.summary: We present Youtu-Parsing-Omni, an omni-modal parser that converts documents, images, audio, and video into structured records grounded in space and time, providing a perception layer for agents that read, locate, and cite evidence across modalities. Its design rests on one encoder for every modality and one schema for every task. First, standard benchmarks fix the number of speakers at two and ignore the near-/far-field interference, reverberation, and sudden noise of real scenes. items.title_en: TAO: Tool-Aware Joint Scheduling for LLM-Based Agentic Serving
items.summary: Agentic services alternate between model inference on clustered GPUs and external tools on distributed CPUs. In this scenario, existing systems (1) overlook tool-return readiness in service evaluation, wasting limited resources, and (2) use heuristic strategies to decide admission and placement on GPUs, resulting in suboptimal scheduling decisions. items.title_cn: TAO：面向LLM智能体服务的工具感知联合调度

The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) suggests that as representations improve, modalities such as vision and language converge toward a shared statistical model of reality. items.title_cn: 感觉运动对齐：具身策略成功的柏拉图式代理指标
items.note: 探索用离线表征对齐指标替代昂贵的机器人闭环评测。

items.title_en: RealCLI: Toward a Unified Evaluation of Human-Agent Collaboration for CLI Agents
items.summary: Command-line interface (CLI) agents increasingly execute longer-horizon tasks, yet existing benchmarks either assume that user instructions remain fixed throughout execution or evaluate task outcomes without capturing runtime collaboration quality. In this paper, we present REALCLI, a paired benchmark that unifies the evaluation of task execution and human-agent collaboration quality on realistic CLI tasks. To comprehensively measure collaboration, REALCLI builds a five-dimensional framework, op
items.title_cn: RealCLI：面向CLI智能体人机协作的统一评测
items.note: 构建配对基准，同时评估命令行任务执行与人机协作质量。

items.title_en: ChronoReplay: One Answer Interface Is Not Enough for Streaming Spatial Intelligence
items.summary: Training a spatial VLM to answer which side an object lies on does not require it to preserve the metric displacement that determines that answer, while supervision for a distance estimate may leave categorical relations largely unconstrained. When post-training emphasizes one readout, improvements can therefore concentrate on that interface while transfer to others remains weak or even degrades; we call this observed specialization interface lock-in. ChronoReplay addresses it by replaying heter
items.title_cn: ChronoReplay：单一答案接口不足以支撑流式空间智能
items.note: 指出空间VLM存在接口锁定，用异构重放缓解单一读出过拟合。

items.title_en: The Trinity:Capability-Driven Recursive Self-Improvement for Multimodal Agents
items.summary: Multimodal intelligence can be viewed as human-guided co-evolution between worlds and agents through interaction. However, scaling this process faces two bottlenecks: constructing heterogeneous, verifiable environments is costly, and manual Harness iteration cannot keep pace with growing task diversity and complexity. A key insight is that tasks with different modalities and surface forms can share the same underlying capability requirements. We therefore introduce The Trinity, a recursive self-
items.title_cn: 三位一体：面向多模态智能体的能力驱动递归自我改进
items.note: 按共享能力需求构建可验证环境，实现多模态智能体递归自我改进。

items.title_en: Multiscale Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
items.summary: Long-horizon LLM agents interact with their environments through complete assistant turns while generating each action token by token. We observe that critic values vary primarily across turns, motivating optimization anchored at turns with finer credit allocation among tokens. We propose Multiscale Policy Optimization (MPO), combining Multiscale Advantage Estimation (MAE) and turn-level importance sampling to align credit assignment and policy updates at the turn scale. Extensive experiments ac
items.title_cn: 面向长程LLM智能体的多尺度策略优化
items.note: 观察到评论家价值主要随轮次变化，提出轮级优势估计与策略更新。

items.title_en: Memory Tax: Dissecting the Net Value of Agent Memory
items.summary: Memory is increasingly used in long-horizon agents, yet the net value of building memory over direct retrieval from raw history remains largely unclear. Through a large-scale evaluation across multiple benchmarks and model backbones, we find many dedicated memory systems underperform naive RAG in many cases, indicating a negative net value. Taking RAG as a reference, we dissect the net value of memory into the gains and losses over direct retrieval, termed memory benefit and memory tax. These ga
items.title_cn: 记忆税：剖析智能体记忆的净价值
items.note: 大规模评测发现专用记忆常不如朴素RAG，将净价值拆为收益与税。

items.title_en: PDRVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model with Physical Dynamics Representations
items.summary: Vision--Language--Action (VLA) models generate robot actions from visual observations and language instructions, but their understanding of physical dynamics remains limited. Video world models can capture scene dynamics, yet generating future videos introduces high latency into the control loop. We introduce PDRVLA, whose lightweight Physical Dynamics Module extracts physical tokens from vision--language features to condition action generation without online video generation. The module learns
items.title_cn: PDRVLA：带物理动态表征的视觉-语言-动作模型
items.note: 用轻量模块提取物理token条件化动作，避免在线生成未来视频的高延迟。

items.title_en: Trajectory2Gym: Decision-Grounded Compositional Interaction Synthesis for Tool-Use Agents
items.summary: Successful tool-use trajectories are not necessarily useful supervision. Even successful interactions may underrepresent multi-step dependencies or contain actions that are unjustified by the information visible to the agent at decision time. We identify two coupled requirements for effective trajectory supervision: compositional coverage, so that important observation-action dependencies are represented, and decision grounding, so that each supervised action is supported by the learner-visible
items.title_cn: Trajectory2Gym：面向工具使用智能体的决策落地组合交互合成
items.note: 指出成功轨迹未必是好监督，强调组合覆盖与决策落地两要求。

items.title_en: Trial by Trace: Benchmarking AI Agent Harnesses for Reliability and Failure Attribution
items.summary: LLM agents are increasingly used to solve real-world problems, and their effectiveness depends on both the underlying models and the harnesses that support their operation. However, most existing benchmarks focus on model capabilities and overall agent performance, with limited attention to the evaluation of agent harnesses. To address this gap, we introduce TraceTrial-Bench, which organizes harness reliability into seven components covering context, execution, governance, lifecycle, observabili
items.title_cn: 轨迹审判：评测AI智能体框架的可靠性与失败归因
items.note: 提出基准把智能体框架可靠性拆成七个组件进行系统评测。

items.title_en: StreamVibe: Proactive Video Agents for Evolving User Intent
items.summary: Vision-language models are shifting from offline passive understanding toward online proactive interaction. However, prevailing methods largely rely on explicit requests while miss the implicit user intent (e.g., "where should I click next?" while a user navigate a website), meanwhile fail to update the state simultaneously as user requests might update continuously. These limitations make them less suited to intent-aware interaction in practical. To address these challenges, we introduce Stream
items.title_cn: StreamVibe：面向演化用户意图的主动视频智能体
items.note: 针对隐式且持续变化的用户意图，提出主动交互的视频智能体。

items.title_en: DynaFlow: Learning Free-Form Multi-Agent Orchestration
items.summary: Multi-agent systems often rely on predefined collaboration structures, limiting their ability to adapt to diverse task requirements. We introduce DynaFlow, a framework that integrates free-form executable workflow synthesis into the action space of the main agent. The agent decides when collaboration is needed and generates task-specific programs that coordinate sub-agents through sequential or parallel execution, structured information exchange, and verification. Execution results and traces in
items.title_cn: DynaFlow：学习自由形式的多智能体编排
items.note: 让主智能体按需生成任务专属程序来编排子智能体，替代预设结构。

items.title_en: InteractiveWorld: A Verifiable Human-Centric Environment for Building Better Interactive MLLM Assistants
items.summary: People have long dreamed of an assistant that is always there to guide them and remind what they forget, from new dishes to lost keys. Powered by multimodal large language models (MLLMs), egocentric AI assistants on wearable devices are bringing this dream within reach: they see what the user sees and give instructions for user's physical work when necessary. However, testing such assistance is challenging and usually requires real people. The expensive and rare real interaction data leaves a ke
items.title_cn: InteractiveWorld：构建更好交互式多模态助手的可验证人本环境
items.note: 构建可验证的人本交互环境，缓解真实交互数据稀缺昂贵问题。

items.title_en: Reading, Writing, Sharing, and Interacting with the World through Video
items.summary: Video foundation models have advanced rapidly in understanding and generating visual sequences, while video world models seek to capture the underlying dynamics of the world they depict. Despite their different objectives, both concern the relationship between video observations and an evolving world. This survey adopts world modeling as a unifying lens for examining these developments. Viewing an observed video as a partial, lossy, and temporally ordered projection of a latent temporal world, w
items.title_cn: 通过视频阅读、书写、共享并与世界交互
items.note: 以世界建模为统一视角综述视频理解、生成与世界模型的关系。

items.title_en: Function-Space Temporal Self-Distillation for Policy Optimization
items.summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) improves reasoning in language models, but scalar outcomes provide coarse supervision over response trajectories. Self-distillation offers denser token-level guidance by comparing an unassisted policy with a feedback-informed self-teacher, yet the teacher evolves with the student, creating unstable targets and motivating additional regularization. We introduce Function-Space Policy Optimization (FSPO), a single-policy framework that combines
items.title_cn: 面向策略优化的函数空间时序自蒸馏
items.note: 用函数空间策略优化结合自蒸馏，提供更密集稳定的token级监督。

items.title_en: UserArena: Benchmarking Interactive User Simulation for Long-Horizon Shopping Agents
items.summary: Agentic recommendation pursues shopper goals through sequences of context-dependent decisions. Developing and evaluating such policies requires faithful recommendation world models that capture both the interactive shopping environment and users' behavioral responses over long interactions. Existing resources rarely provide long-horizon, fine-grained real-user trajectories or support trajectory-level evaluation and offline validation against production A/B results. We introduce UserArena, a real
items.title_cn: UserArena：面向长程购物智能体的交互式用户模拟评测
items.note: 构建真实长程购物轨迹与用户模拟，支持轨迹级评测和离线验证。

items.title_en: HiSTEVE 1.0: Harnessing Human-Interface VLA Agents for Open-World Games
items.summary: Building virtual embodied agents that operate in open-ended games like human players is a long-standing goal requiring both long-horizon autonomy and reliable native-interface control. As a procedurally generated open world, Minecraft provides a natural testbed for studying the integration of these capabilities. Existing agents typically provide either native visuomotor control without long-horizon autonomy or high-level planning executed through environment APIs or predefined skills. To bridge
items.title_cn: HiSTEVE 1.0：利用人机界面VLA智能体玩开放世界游戏
items.note: 结合原生视觉运动控制与长程自主，在Minecraft中构建虚拟具身智能体。

items.title_en: RynnUnify: Towards Unified Embodied Brain
items.summary: We introduce RynnUnify, a 16B unified embodied model that combines strong embodied understanding with long-horizon visual planning through interleaved video--language reasoning. With capabilities spanning spatial reasoning, physical prediction, and grounding, RynnUnify connects an understanding of the physical world with visual anticipation of how it evolves across successive subtasks. Building on these capabilities, we further develop an agentic extension through reinforcement learning to selec
items.title_cn: RynnUnify：迈向统一具身大脑
items.note: 16B统一具身模型，结合具身理解与交错视频语言的长程视觉规划。

items.title_en: WeVisOne-VL: Unified Visual Perception from Objects to Pixels
items.summary: Existing vision-language models (VLMs) remain unreliable for fine-grained visual perception. In this report, we present WeVisOne-VL (WeChat Vision All-in-One), a powerful VLM that unifies object-level and pixel-level perception through structured next-token prediction. It supports multiple visual tasks including object detection, referring localization, counting, OCR, segmentation, and matting, enabling localization at any user-specific granularity, from points and boxes to masks and alpha matte
items.title_cn: WeVisOne-VL：从物体到像素的统一视觉感知
items.note: 用结构化下一token预测统一物体级与像素级感知，支持多视觉任务。

items.title_en: Deep Search in Real-World Web Environments
items.summary: Despite substantial progress in Deep Search agents, their ability to conduct end-to-end research in real-world open Web environments remains insufficiently evaluated. Unlike static retrieval settings, information on the real-world Web is distributed across diverse sources, modalities, and heterogeneous formats, often involving complex interaction mechanisms that require agents to autonomously search for, access, and integrate relevant evidence during execution. To address this gap, we introduce
items.title_cn: 真实网络环境中的深度搜索
items.note: 构建真实开放网络环境，评测深度搜索智能体端到端研究能力。

items.title_en: Making MLLM Latents Matter: Factor-Aware Predictive Learning for Cinematic Video Generation
items.summary: Cinematic video generation requires both temporal inference from limited inputs (i.e., sparse rather than frame-by-frame guidance) and factor-aware control of character, scene, action, and camera. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offer useful priors for both capabilities, but their representations are not automatically actionable for video generation: a Video Diffusion Transformer (DiT) may bypass them through native conditioning pathways, and using them does not ensure either factor-awa
items.title_cn: 让多模态大模型隐表示起作用：面向电影级视频生成的因子感知预测学习
items.note: 让MLLM表征真正作用于视频生成，实现角色场景动作镜头因子控制。

items.title_en: Editing Images into Reusable Layers via Compositional Edit-Prior Distillation
items.summary: High-quality image editing requires precise modification of target regions while preserving the content of unrelated regions. Existing editing models produce flattened outputs that limit precise local manipulation and layer reuse, while decomposition methods typically optimize layer recovery separately from instruction-driven editing. To this end, we introduce LayerEditor, a unified framework that couples instruction-guided image editing with controllable generation of reusable RGBA layers. At i
items.title_cn: 通过组合编辑先验蒸馏把图像编辑成可复用图层
items.note: 统一指令引导编辑与可控RGBA图层生成，支持局部操作与图层复用。

items.title_en: IQuest-Q1: Advancing Foundation Capabilities for Agentic CLI Systems
items.summary: We present IQuest-Q1, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) agentic foundation model with 320B total parameters (15B activated). IQuest-Q1 is developed through a three-stage process: (1) stable and efficient pre-training, combining Stable SplitNorm, Muon, and muP with a two-stage curriculum whose second stage increases the coding-data mixture, preserving a wide stability margin between safe and optimal learning rates; (2) fine-grained mid-training, expanding the data mixture across domains and forma
items.title_cn: IQuest-Q1：推进智能体CLI系统的基础能力
items.note: 320B稀疏MoE智能体基础模型，经三阶段训练强化CLI智能体能力。

items.title_en: Spectral-Spatial Interpretation
items.summary: Post-hoc image explanations usually show where a model looks using spatial heatmaps or indicate which channels matter using global channel scores. These separate views are limiting for multispectral data because channel relevance is often spatially localized and physically meaningful. We introduce Spectral-Spatial Interpretation (SSI), a full-grid attribution method over position-channel players (g,c). For each spatial position, SSI fixes the observed surrounding context, defines a conditional g
items.title_cn: 光谱-空间解释
items.note: 提出位置-通道全网格归因方法，刻画多光谱数据中局部化的通道相关性。

items.title_en: StreamEval: Evaluating Interactive Streaming Video Generation Models
items.summary: As streaming video generation advances, enabling real-time interaction with generated video is becoming increasingly important. We introduce StreamEval, a unified benchmark for interactive streaming video generation spanning five tasks: avatar dialogue, avatar performance, world generation, instruction editing, and reference editing. StreamEval comprises 300 scripted test cases lasting 15-300s, each specifying initial assets, incrementally arriving multimodal requests, and explicit requirements
items.title_cn: StreamEval：评测交互式流式视频生成模型
items.note: 统一基准覆盖五类任务，评测流式视频生成的实时交互能力。

items.title_en: Right Screen, Wrong Transition: World Models as Verifiers for GUI Agents
items.summary: A login screen that appears after a tap on Sign in is expected; the same screen after a tap on View order is an attack. For GUI agents, safety is therefore a property of the transition rather than of the screen, and a monitor that inspects only screens can be defeated by reusing a legitimate one. Judging a transition requires an expectation of what should have followed the action. Existing GUI world models provide one, but they output it as text, code, or images, so checking it against the obser
items.title_cn: 界面对了，跳转错了：用世界模型验证GUI智能体
items.note: 指出GUI安全在于状态转移而非单屏，用世界模型校验转移是否合理。

items.title_en: Cache Engineering for Agents
items.summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents can handle increasingly complex tasks, navigating long trajectories of observations and actions. As these trajectories grow, key-value (KV) cache I/O and storage become the dominant cost. Trajectories can also exceed the LLM's maximum context length, requiring control over active cache growth. Prior work uses context engineering to reduce cache size by trimming or summarizing history. However, modifying the trajectory prefix invalidates subsequent cached states
items.title_cn: 智能体的缓存工程
items.note: 针对长轨迹KV缓存I/O与存储瓶颈，研究不破坏前缀缓存的缓存管理。

items.title_en: DONIC: Generalist Dexterous Bimanual Tracking Control from Human Demonstrations
items.summary: Despite recent progress in dexterous reference tracking, existing models focus primarily on single-hand manipulation and a limited range of interactions, leaving the bimanual dexterous behaviors common in real life unaddressed. The scarcity of contact-rich bimanual manipulation data and the increased complexity of coordinating contacts make developing a generalist bimanual tracker particularly challenging. Therefore, we present 1) DONIC, the first generalist bimanual tracker jointly trained acro
items.title_cn: DONIC：从人类示范学习通用双臂灵巧跟踪控制
items.note: 首个联合训练双手的通用灵巧跟踪器，应对接触丰富的双臂操作。

huggingface.models_summary: 这批热门模型里，文本生成仍占主流，既有33B的大模型，也有1.7B的小模型；同时出现图文多模态和语音识别模型，说明AI正从纯文字走向多模态。另外，同一模型推出GGUF量化版，反映本地化、轻量化部署需求在增长。对跟进AI圈和备考的人，值得留意模型规模、任务类型和量化部署这几条主线。
huggingface.papers_summary: 这批论文集中在智能体（Agent）与多模态两大方向：智能体侧关注长程任务、工具调用、记忆价值、缓存与评测框架；多模态侧聚焦扩散与视频生成、视觉语言模型、具身机器人与世界模型。新手可记住这些关键词：Agent、多模态、扩散模型、视觉语言模型（VLM）、具身智能、世界模型、强化学习、基准评测。
